titleEn: How Much Does a Second Storey Addition Cost in Vancouver in 2026?
titleZh: 溫哥華二樓加建造價 2026：完整造價指南
contentEn:
Adding a second storey to your Vancouver home in 2026 costs between $500,000 and $1,500,000 for a full addition with structural work and premium finishes — but selective second storey additions on smaller homes can start as low as $250,000. The final cost depends on your home's square footage, the complexity of structural changes, permit requirements, and finish level. This guide breaks down every cost line so you can budget accurately before signing a contract.

Second Storey Addition Cost Breakdown by Scope

Every second storey addition project is different, but Reno Stars tracks real costs across Metro Vancouver so you can enter the process with a realistic number. The table below reflects 2026 pricing from actual whole-house and addition projects in Vancouver, Burnaby, and Richmond.

What Drives Second Storey Addition Costs Higher

Beyond the basic square-foot cost, several pre-construction conditions unique to Vancouver homes add significant line items to your project. These are not optional — they are regulatory requirements that every homeowner must address.

  • Asbestos abatement (pre-1990 homes): $8,000 – $40,000 depending on the extent of asbestos-containing materials in walls, insulation, and flooring. BC law requires a certified abatement contractor before demolition begins.
  • Knob-and-tube wiring replacement (pre-1950 homes): $15,000 – $35,000. Knob-and-tube cannot be buried in insulation and must be fully replaced; this is one of the most common hidden costs in Vancouver older-home additions.
  • Galvanized supply line replacement: $8,000 – $25,000. Most homes built before 1970 still have galvanized steel pipes, which must be replaced as part of a major addition.
  • 200A electrical panel upgrade: $5,000 – $10,000. A second storey with multiple new circuits typically requires a service upgrade.
  • BC Building Code permit package (second storey scope): $5,000 – $15,000 in City of Vancouver fees for a full addition permit.
  • Heritage Alteration Permit (pre-1940 homes in Heritage Conservation Areas): $2,000 – $8,000 in additional City of Vancouver fees and specialist reports.
  • Structural engineer and architect (premium or structural scope): $15,000 – $50,000. Required for any load-bearing wall removal or dormer construction.
  • Roof raise or dormer construction: $15,000 – $35,000 if the existing roof must be modified to create headroom for a second storey.

Second Storey Addition Timeline in Vancouver

A selective second storey addition on a 1,800 sq ft Vancouver home typically runs 10–14 months from first meeting to final inspection. A full upper-floor addition with structural changes and premium finishes runs 14–24 months. This includes:

  • Structural assessment and engineer report: 2–4 weeks
  • BC Building Code permit application and approval: 6–12 weeks (City of Vancouver backlog means realistic timeline is 10–14 weeks for a full addition)
  • Heritage review (if applicable): additional 4–8 weeks
  • Demolition and abatement: 2–4 weeks
  • Structural work and framing: 4–8 weeks
  • Mechanical rough-ins (electrical, plumbing, HVAC): 3–6 weeks
  • Insulation, drywall, and finishing: 6–10 weeks
  • Final inspection andoccupancy: 1–2 weeks

Do You Need a Permit for a Second Storey Addition in Vancouver?

Yes. Every second storey addition in Vancouver requires a BC Building Code permit. The permit package must include structural engineer drawings, load calculations, and in older homes a dedicated asbestos assessment report. Skipping permits to save time or money exposes you to mandatory demolition orders, fines, and problems when you sell the home. Reno Stars handles the full permit application on your behalf as part of every addition project.

Second Storey Addition vs. Move: Which Is Better in 2026?

For Vancouver homeowners sitting on significant equity, a second storey addition often costs less than selling and buying a comparable home. The average Vancouver detached home sold for over $2 million in 2025 — adding a second storey for $500,000–$900,000 to gain 800–1,200 sq ft is frequently the better financial decision, especially when you factor in moving costs, realtor fees, and land transfer tax. Second Storey Addition Cost Vancouver 2026 — FAQ

How much does a second storey addition cost in Vancouver in 2026?

A selective second storey addition in Vancouver starts at $250,000 for a simple 1–2 room upper-floor addition with no structural changes. A full second storey with 2–3 bedrooms, bathrooms, and structural work ranges $400,000–$700,000. Premium additions with load-bearing wall removal and designer finishes run $700,000–$1,000,000. These figures include BC Building Code permits, asbestos abatement, and all trades under one contract.

Do I need a permit for a second storey addition in Vancouver?

Yes. Every second storey addition in Vancouver requires a BC Building Code permit. A heritage assessment is also required for homes built before 1940 in designated Heritage Conservation Areas. The permit application must include structural engineer drawings and an asbestos assessment (mandatory for any pre-1990 home). Reno Stars manages the entire permit process.

How long does a second storey addition take in Vancouver?

A selective second storey addition takes 10–14 months from initial consultation to final inspection. A full upper-floor addition with structural changes takes 14–24 months. The longest phases are permit approval (6–14 weeks) and finishing work (6–10 weeks). Pre-construction conditions like knob-and-tube wiring or asbestos abatement add 2–6 weeks before demolition begins.

What is the biggest hidden cost in Vancouver second storey additions?

Knob-and-tube wiring replacement is the most commonly missed pre-construction cost. Pre-1950 Vancouver homes almost always have knob-and-tube wiring that must be fully replaced before insulation can be added around the new second storey. The cost is $15,000–$35,000 and must be completed before framing begins. Asbestos abatement ($8,000–$40,000 on pre-1990 homes) is the second most common surprise.

Is a second storey addition worth it in Vancouver?

For most Vancouver homeowners, yes. With detached home prices averaging over $2 million in Metro Vancouver in 2025, adding a second storey for $500,000–$900,000 to gain usable square footage is typically more cost-effective than selling and buying a new home. You also avoid realtor fees (typically 5–6% of sale price), BC Property Transfer Tax, and the stress of moving. Reno Stars offers a free cost-benefit analysis during the initial consultation.

contentZh:
在溫哥華為房屋加建二樓，2026 年的造價範圍為 50 萬至 150 萬加元（含結構工程和優質飾面的完整加建項目），而在較小型住宅上進行的選擇性二樓加建項目最低可從 25 萬加元起。最終造價取決於房屋建築面積、主體結構變更的複雜程度、許可要求及飾面層次。本文詳細細分各項成本，協助您在簽約前準確預算。

二樓加建造價按工程範圍細分

每個二樓加建項目各有不同，但 Reno Stars 追蹤大溫哥華地區真實造價數據，讓您以務實的數字進入流程。下表反映 2026 年溫哥華、本拿比及列治文實際整屋及加建項目的造價。

工程範圍包含內容2026 年造價範圍
選擇性二樓加建（1–2 個新房，無結構變更）主臥+套房，無需拆除承重牆25 萬 – 40 萬加元
中檔二樓加建（新增 2,000–2,500 平方英尺）完整上層、2–3 間臥室、2 間浴室、屋頂抬高或老虎窗40 萬 – 70 萬加元
含結構變更的高檔二樓加建拆除承重牆、佈局重新配置、定制飾面70 萬 – 100 萬加元
豪華完整二樓加建（4,500+ 平方英尺，豪華飾面）配備設計師飾面、智能家居布線、景觀一體化的完整上層100 萬 – 150 萬加元
超豪華/傳統二樓修復現代化系統定期修復、專業行業、定制組件150 萬 – 300 萬加元以上

哪些因素會增加二樓加建成本

除了基本的每平方英尺造價外，溫哥華房屋的若干施工前條件會為項目增加可觀的額外費用。這些並非可選項目——而是每位業主必須解決的監管要求。

  • 石棉消除（1990 年前房屋）：8,000 – 40,000 加元，視乎牆壁、保溫層和地板中石棉含量材料的程度而定。BC 省法律要求在拆除前聘請持牌石棉清除承包商。
  • 旋鈕和管布線更換（1950 年前房屋）：15,000 – 35,000 加元。旋鈕和管布線不能埋在保溫層中，必須完全更換；這是溫哥華老房屋加建項目中最常見的隱藏成本之一。
  • 鍍鋅供水管更換：8,000 – 25,000 加元。1970 年之前建造的大多數房屋仍然使用鍍鋅鋼管，必須在大型加建項目中更換。
  • 200A 電錶箱升級：5,000 – 10,000 加元。帶多條新電路的二樓加建通常需要服務升級。
  • BC 建築規範許可包（二樓加建範圍）：完整的 City of Vancouver 許可費用為 5,000 – 15,000 加元。
  • 傳統改造許可證（傳統保護區的 1940 年前房屋）：額外的 City of Vancouver 費用及專家報告為 2,000 – 8,000 加元。
  • 結構工程師及建築師（高檔或結構工程範圍）：15,000 – 50,000 加元。任何拆除承重牆或老虎窗工程均需配備。
  • 屋頂抬高或老虎窗工程：15,000 – 35,000 加元（若現有屋頂須修改以為二樓創造淨高）。

溫哥華二樓加建時間表

在 1,800 平方英尺的溫哥華房屋上進行選擇性二樓加建，從首次會議到最終檢查通常需要 10–14 個月。含結構工程和豪華飾面的完整上層加建需要 14–24 個月。時間表包括：

  • 結構評估及工程師報告：2–4 週
  • BC 建築規範許可證申請及批准：6–12 週（City of Vancouver 積壓個案意味完整加建許可的實際時間為 10–14 週）
  • 傳統評審（如適用）：額外 4–8 週
  • 拆除及消除：2–4 週
  • 結構工程及框架：4–8 週
  • 機械粗裝修（電氣、管道、HVAC）：3–6 週
  • 保溫層、石膏板及飾面：6–10 週
  • 最終檢查及入住：1–2 週

查看我們的溫哥華整屋翻新項目，了解在溫哥華進行二樓工程的真實案例。

溫哥華二樓加建是否需要許可證？

需要。溫哥華的每個二樓加建項目均需 BC 建築規範許可證。許可包必須包括結構工程師圖紙、負荷計算，對於較老房屋還需提供專門的石棉評估報告。跳過許可證以節省時間或金錢，會使您面臨強制拆除令、罰款，以及售屋時的麻煩。Reno Stars 在每個加建項目中代您處理完整的許可申請流程。

二樓加建與搬家：2026 年哪個更划算？

對於坐擁可觀資產的溫哥華業主來說，二樓加建的費用通常低於出售及購買同類房屋。2025 年溫哥華獨立屋平均售價超過 200 萬加元——以 50 萬至 90 萬加元建造二樓以增加 800–1,200 平方英尺使用空間，通常是更佳的財務決定，尤其是當您將搬家成本、地產代理費用及土地轉讓稅計算在內時。Reno Stars 在免費初步諮詢期間提供詳細的成本效益分析。

溫哥華二樓加建造價 2026 — 常見問題

2026 年溫哥華二樓加建造價多少？

溫哥華的選擇性二樓加建，無需結構變更的簡單 1–2 房上層加建，起價 25 萬加元。帶 2–3 間臥室、浴室及結構工程的完整二樓加建為 40 萬至 70 萬加元。含拆除承重牆及設計師飾面的豪華加建為 70 萬至 100 萬加元。以上造價均含 BC 建築規範許可證、石棉清除及同一合約下的所有工程。

溫哥華二樓加建是否需要許可證？

需要。溫哥華的每個二樓加建項目均需 BC 建築規範許可證。1940 年前建於傳統保護區的房屋還需要傳統評估。許可證申請須包含結構工程師圖紙及石棉評估（1990 年前房屋必備）。Reno Stars 代您管理整個許可流程。

溫哥華二樓加建需要多長時間？

選擇性二樓加建從初步諮詢到最終檢查需要 10–14 個月。含結構工程的上層加建需要 14–24 個月。最漫長的階段是許可批准（6–14 週）及飾面工程（6–10 週）。旋鈕和管布線或石棉清除等施工前條件會在拆除前額外增加 2–6 週。

溫哥華二樓加建最大的隱藏成本是什麼？

旋鈕和管布線更換是最容易忽略的施工前成本。幾乎所有 1950 年前建造的溫哥華房屋都有旋鈕和管布線，必須在保溫層可添加到新二樓之前完全更換。費用為 15,000–35,000 加元，必須在框架工程開始前完成。石棉清除（1990 年前房屋為 8,000–40,000 加元）是第二常見的意外費用。

二樓加建在溫哥華值得嗎？

對大多數溫哥華業主來說，值得。2025 年大溫哥華地區獨立屋平均售價超過 200 萬加元，以 50 萬至 90 萬加元建造二樓以增加可用建築面積，通常比出售及購買新屋更具成本效益。您還可避免地產代理費（通常為售價的 5–6%）、BC 房產轉讓稅及搬家的壓力。Reno Stars 在初步諮詢期間提供免費的成本效益分析。
